request.style: English, classic soul, warm smoky female vocal with backing singers, Rhodes piano, horn section, round bass, laid-back drums, tender and sincere, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nobody has seen the Father, nobody has seen his face
But love has come among us and it's living in this place
He sent his only Son to us so we might live through him
That's how his love was shown to us, his love was shown in him

[Chorus]
Dear friends, let us love one another
For love is from God
Whoever does not love does not know God
Because God is love

[Verse]
It was not that we loved him first, we never reached that high
But he loved us and sent his Son for our sins to die
So if God loved us like this, then we know what to do
We ought to love each other like he loved me and you

[Chorus]
Dear friends, let us love one another
For love is from God
Whoever does not love does not know God
Because God is love

[Bridge]
This is love: not that we have loved God
But that he loved us and sent his Son
As the atoning sacrifice for our sins
No one has ever seen God
But if we love one another, God remains in us

[Outro]
Because God is love
Dear friends, let us love one another
